errors.evidence: The x-axis categories are evaluation types (实体识别、角色识别、异常识别、空间推理、同义识别), not system types.

errors.text_span: “实体词数”区域的蓝色柱状图约为 1008， “验证词数”区域的橙色柱状图约为 1102， “异同词别”区域的蓝色柱状图约为 920， “空间推理”区域的橙色柱状图约为 700，而“同义词别”区域的蓝色柱状图约为 55
errors.evidence: The bar labels and colors do not match the chart: blue bars are 1102, 1095, 1077, 1210, and 5; orange bars are 250, 190, 40, 675, and 55 for the five categories, respectively. The description assigns incorrect values and colors/categories.

errors.text_span: 垂直轴表示数值大小，刻度是线性的，从 0.1 到 1.2，刻度间隔为 0.1
errors.evidence: The right y-axis is labeled from 0 to 1 with tick marks every 0.1, while the left y-axis for the bars ranges roughly from 0 to 1200. The description misstates the value range.

errors.text_span: 灰色线连接所有柱状图，并从最左侧的“实体词数”柱状图开始，延伸到最右侧的“同义词别”柱状图
errors.evidence: The gray line represents accuracy values across the categories; it is not described as connecting all bars as a separate visual element starting from the leftmost bar. Also the categories are misnamed in the description.
